title: Fun Run
one_paragraph_synopsis: In 'Fun Run,' the office experiences a series of chaotic events including Michael hitting Meredith with his car, Angela's suspicion about her cat's death, and a charity fun run. The episode explores office relationships, personal struggles, and humorous misunderstandings, culminating in Michael reflecting on the office's 'curse' and his own efforts to overcome it.
